description: Gares et haltes ferroviaires d'Occitanie is a dataset listed in Occitanie open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Région Occitanie. Cette couche géographique représente les gares et haltes ferroviaires d'Occitanie. Elle a été générée à partir de la base ROUTE 500®. Coverage: Occitanie. The portal files it under Transports et Mobilité. Its keywords are gare, halte, ferroviaire. The portal shows 297 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-01-16 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-laregion-fr-portal.
